mechanism: Old D design colored the source and D black/white quarter arcs to suppress the first horizontal flip, giving D/A. New E design removes every old arc mark and pairs straight diameter and black-white divider directions under (x,y)->(-y,-x), a single diagonal reflection. This is a different transformation error; E shares the correct black quarter location but fails the complete semicircle orientation, explicitly addressing the old audit warning that black-quarter matching alone is insufficient.
primary_math_proof: Relative to card center the first leftward flip is H=diag(-1,1), then upward V=diag(1,-1). VH=-I; printed side returns. Source semicircle y<=0 therefore becomes y>=0 and source black lower-left quarter becomes black upper-right. Only A has BOTH. B left semicircle, C lower, E right all fail the enclosing semicircle; D upper semicircle has black upper-left and fails fill. The false map R=[0,-1;-1,0] sends the diameter horizontal to vertical and downward black-white divider rightward, matching E, but is not VH. No arrow or printed fill changes.

marker_roles.role: Source whole horizontal semicircle diameter, first orientation-defining axis.
Existing source downward radial divider between black and white quarters, second orientation-defining feature.
E vertical semicircle diameter, paired by the false diagonal-mirror map instead of the true halfturn.
E rightward radial divider, the exact false image of the source downward radius under reflection in y=-x.

human_semantics: Only existing contour styles; all original geometry, text and fill unchanged. Colors are correspondence annotations and not extra physical ink constraints. No new cut, region, condition or puzzle part. Actual native PNG primary review required before calls.
